name: What should I do if my kitchen sink is completely clogged?

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my kitchen sink is completely clogged?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your kitchen sink is completely clogged, avoid using chemical drain cleaners as they can damage pipes and aren't always effective. First, try using a plunger. Ensure a tight seal around the drain and plunge vigorously. If that doesn't work, inspect the P-trap under the sink for blockages. Place a bucket underneath, then carefully remove the trap to clear any debris. If the clog persists after these steps, it's best to call a professional plumber to properly diagnose and resolve the issue without causing further damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Try plunging or clearing the P-trap. If unsuccessful, avoid chemical cleaners and call a professional plumber.
